//: Production overrides for devnet.khaneazam.com (Plesk). Layered on top of appsettings.json by ASP.NET Core when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production. Committed with real secrets on purpose — same call as .env.local.

Scraper.//: Same key used for local dev. Capped at 100 Places Text Search requests/day unless billing is enabled on the Cloud project — searches fall back to OpenStreetMap once that's exhausted, they don't fail.

Swagger.//: Open with no credentials. RequireAuthentication must be explicitly false, not just Username/Password removed — with no credentials and RequireAuthentication still true, the middleware fails closed (404) rather than publishing anonymously.

EmailValidation.//: EnableSmtpProbe turned on 2026-09-03 after a ~50% bounce rate on real sends showed DNS-only "Valid" (an MX record exists) wasn't enough to trust — this adds a live RCPT TO check on its own slower, per-domain-rate-limited pass (EmailSmtpProbeWorkerService) before a lead's status can actually claim Valid. EnableBounceProcessing, also turned on the same day, is the other half: it never sends anything, it just reads BounceCheckUsername's own inbox for the delivery-failure notices real campaign sends already produce (EmailBounceProcessorService), so a hard-bounced address gets suppressed from future sends automatically. EnableBounceCheck stays off — that one actually sends a probe email; flip it on only once you're ready for that.
